title: Rewriting a directed acyclic circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a circuit on $n$ inputs whose gates are in topological order and whose output is a vertex of the circuit. Given natural number $c$, predicates $Q$ on gate kinds and arities and $P$ on gates, and an emitter that is gadget-correct for these parameters, assume every gate of $C$ satisfies $Q$ for its kind and arity. The rewritten circuit has the gate list produced by processing the gates of $C$ from left to right, and its output is the rewritten index corresponding to the original output, using $0$ if that index is out of range.
